improvements.title: Implement User Activity Tracking for Active Users
improvements.expectedEffect: Enable measurement of recent user engagement, allowing for data-driven improvements to retention and feature development.
improvements.rationale: The 'activeUsersLast7d' metric is null due to a lack of a defined activity. Implementing a clear definition and tracking mechanism is crucial for understanding user behavior and platform health.

improvements.title: Implement 7-Day View Tracking
improvements.expectedEffect: Provide insights into content consumption trends and popular topics within the last week, informing content strategy.
improvements.rationale: The 'viewsLast7d' metric is null. Tracking recent views is essential for understanding content performance and user interest.

improvements.title: Develop User Acquisition Campaigns
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase the 'newUsersLast7d' metric, indicating successful growth and attraction of new community members.
improvements.rationale: With 'newUsersLast7d' at 0, there is an urgent need to attract new users to ensure the platform's sustainability and growth.

improvements.title: Incentivize Recent Comment Creation
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase 'commentsLast7d', fostering community interaction and content discussion.
improvements.rationale: Zero comments in the last 7 days suggest a lack of recent community interaction, which is vital for a community platform.

improvements.title: Promote Content Diversity Across Corridors
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase post counts in underrepresented corridors (e.g., BUILD, GOSSIP, LAUNCH, RECIPE, AI_FORTUNE, GALLERY) and potentially drive engagement in those areas.
improvements.rationale: The heavy concentration of posts in 'LOUNGE' may indicate a need to encourage content creation and participation in other specialized areas of the platform.

expectedUserEffect: Implementing these improvements is expected to lead to increased user acquisition, higher engagement rates (comments, active usage), better understanding of user behavior and content performance, and potentially a more balanced community across different corridors.
expectedDifficulty: Medium to High, with user acquisition and defining/tracking active users being the most challenging.
